_doc: Route-test Qwen asset pod (2026-11-06). Plan: the Fable thread's OR-23 plan (creator 'კი' 07:37 UTC), brief ASSET_POD_BRIEF.md. Every setting is fixed by the creator or by qa/style_prompt.INFERENCE; nothing here is a new choice.

pano_lora.licence: qwen-research (derivative of Qwen-Image-2.1; LICENSE.md in the repo)
pano_lora.trigger: Fill the green areas to complete a seamless 360° equirectangular panorama.

sampler.negative: text, lettering, letters, words, watermark, signature, photo, 3d render

flat: flat ambient lighting, no cast shadows, plain neutral background

H1.name: commander
H1.look: a middle-aged commander, broad shoulders, grey-streaked beard, scarred chin, steel breastplate over a dark red tunic, fur-collared cloak.

H2.name: scout
H2.look: a young scout, wiry, freckled, messy short hair, hooded green cloak, leather jerkin, short bow in hand.

H3.name: elder
H3.look: an old council elder, thin and stooped, long white beard, deep blue robe with gold trim, round spectacles.

backdrops: xworld style, empty tent camp at dusk, canvas tents in rings around a dying fire, banners on poles, hills fading into purple haze, warm firelight and a low orange sun.
xworld style, empty castle courtyard at noon, stone keep and wall towers, a well and a cart of hay, banners hanging, hard sun straight above.
xworld style, empty open battlefield on an overcast morning, trampled mud and broken spears, drifting mist, a dark forest line far away, cold low light from the east.
xworld style, empty wooden ship deck at sea, tall mast with a patched sail, coiled ropes and barrels, rolling waves to the horizon, golden afternoon sun low over the water.
scenes: xworld style, two armies clash at a river ford, a knight on a rearing horse swings his sword, spray flying, banners falling, thin smoke, low red sun behind the hills.
xworld style, two swordsmen duel in a castle courtyard, one lunges while the other parries with sparks flying, soldiers watching, harsh noon sun, a toppled barrel.
xworld style, inside a tent a commander seen from behind faces a young scout who pleads with open hands, a map on a table, one oil lamp glowing warm.
xworld style, a long column of tired soldiers marches along a muddy road in heavy rain, cloaks soaked, horses with bowed heads, a limp banner, storm clouds with one weak gold break.
xworld style, a quiet battlefield after the fight, broken shields and spears in the mud, smoke drifting over the field, one soldier sitting with his helmet, crows landing, red dawn.
xworld style, a commander's face filling the picture, eyes narrowed and fixed on something off to the side, a torch flame flickering on his beard, one drop of sweat, dark tent behind him.
scenes_d2: xworld style, two armies clash at a river ford at the end of a long day, a knight on a rearing horse swings his sword high while his banner-bearer topples into the water, spray flying from hooves and shields, foot soldiers stumbling and shouting in the shallows, a broken spear floating past, thin smoke drifting over the far bank, a low red sun sinking behind the hills and painting the river with glowing orange streaks.

xworld style, two swordsmen duel in a castle courtyard at harsh noon, one lunges with a wild grin while the other parries and sparks fly from the blades, soldiers in a ring watching with wide eyes, a toppled barrel rolling across the cobbles, a nervous dog backing away, banners hanging still on the keep wall, hard sun straight above throwing short sharp shadows.

xworld style, inside a canvas tent a broad commander seen from behind faces a young scout who pleads with open trembling hands, a map spread on a rough table with pebbles holding its corners, one oil lamp glowing warm and throwing flickering shapes on the tent walls, a sword leaning on a chest, rain tapping the canvas, tension and exhaustion in the air.

xworld style, a long column of tired soldiers marches along a muddy road in heavy rain, cloaks soaked and heads bowed, horses with drooping heads pulling a creaking cart, a limp banner hanging from a bent pole, puddles splashing under heavy boots, a lone drummer boy at the front, storm clouds piled over bare hills with one weak gold break of light far ahead.

xworld style, a quiet battlefield after the fight at red dawn, broken shields and spears stuck in the churned mud, smoke drifting low over the field, one soldier sitting alone holding his dented helmet with a blank stare, crows landing on a fallen banner, a riderless horse standing in the mist, a faint cold wind and the first red light on the ridge.

xworld style, a commander's face filling the picture, eyes narrowed and fixed on something off to the side, a torch flame flickering on his grey-streaked beard and scarred chin, one drop of sweat sliding down his temple, a jaw clenched tight with fear he refuses to show, a dark tent behind him with a faint glow from a lamp.
hero_in_place: xworld style, Image 1 is the {name}: keep his face, build and clothes exactly. Image 2 is the place: keep it as it is. Draw the {name} standing in that place in a relaxed pose, lit by the light of the place.
